result.title: Polarimetric Scattering-Structure Contrastive Learning for Few-Shot HRRP Recognition
result.summary: Few-shot high-resolution range profile (HRRP) recognition is challenged by strong aspect-dependent variation and sparse novel-class support. We propose polarimetric scattering-structure contrastive learning (PSS-CL), which supplies an episodic HRRP encoder with a structured physical training view. Dominant local responses are represented by their soft affinities to canonical polarimetric mechanisms, normalized range locations, and energy contributions. A symmetric cross-view objective transfers this scattering structure to the learned HRRP representation, while episodic prototype learning supports novel-class inference without the physical branch. We conduct Random-aspect and Cross-aspect experiments on a six-class measured dataset. In Cross-aspect 1-, 3-, and 5-shot recognition, PSS-CL achieves 81.73%, 86.92%, and 90.98% mean class accuracy (MCA), respectively, outperforming the best competing results by 5.62%, 3.09%, and 3.56%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究少样本高分辨距离像（HRRP）雷达目标识别，提出极性散射—结构对比学习，用散射机制的软归属、距离位置与能量构成结构化物理训练视图，将结构迁移到 HRRP 编码器，并在推理时仅用 episodic 原型分类。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于雷达信号少样本分类，不涉及视觉/多模态推理状态生成、证据获取或停止决策；其训练期物理分支虽为辅助监督，但仅为通用结构先验约束，未见可具体迁移到 LVR 的线索。
